Container.Name: hero-slate
Container.Overview: Hero Slate kid-friendly D&D character sheets (Gimdak Steelward). Static SvelteKit build served by nginx. swag (host network) proxies gimdak.iamhome.cloud to 127.0.0.1:3500 behind Authentik forward auth (provider gimdak-forward-auth). The site files are published by deploy/deploy.sh in the hero-slate repo; no secrets.
Container.Requires: The swag proxy conf deploy/gimdak.subdomain.conf, and the Authentik application gimdak.

Config.Name: Site files
Config.Description: Static build published by deploy/deploy.sh. Rebuildable, no backup needed.

Config.Name: nginx config
Config.Description: deploy/nginx.conf from the repo: SPA fallback and cache headers.
